concerns.text: The plan regresses PCA component scores on the subject‑level binary task condition while using window‑level network metrics as predictors. However, the PCA is performed on metrics stacked across all windows and subjects, producing component scores that are effectively per‑window observations. The outcome variable (task_condition) is constant within a subject, so treating each window as an independent data point violates the independence assumption and inflates degrees of freedom. A proper analysis should aggregate metrics at the subject level (e.g., average or summarize across windows) or employ a mixed‑effects model that accounts for within‑subject correlation. Without this correction the permutation test and FDR correction may yield misleading significance.
